en: A vintage beige postcard with printed text and handwritten address. The top reads "POSTKAART — CARTE POSTALE." It bears a green 5-senti Estonian postage stamp with a portrait and is postmarked "TARTU EESTI" dated 24.I.1937. The left side has printed sender information for Johann Toming in Tartu, including address and telephone number. The right side has handwritten recipient information addressed to a woman in Haapsalu, with a street address.
